ValidationRule.description: If the dispute reason is 'Cardholder did not authorise transaction (Fraud)' OR 'Additional transactions for an existing lost/stolen/fraud case' then 'Has the card been stopped?' must be Yes or No.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', OR( ISPICKVAL( Dispute_Reason__c ,'Cardholder did not authorise transaction (Fraud)'), ISPICKVAL( Dispute_Reason__c ,'Additional transactions for an existing lost/stolen/fraud case') ), OR( ISPICKVAL( Has_The_Card_Been_Stopped__c ,'NA'), ISPICKVAL( Has_The_Card_Been_Stopped__c ,'') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For this dispute reason, please select either Yes, No for this field.
